MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Instance Identifier.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Instance Identifier.

InstanceIdentifier.description: Primary instance identifier, equivalent to the first element of InstanceIdentifierData.

InstanceTime.description: Time this Instance Identifier was produced.

InstanceSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Instance is located.

InstanceIdentifierData.description: Ordered set of candidate Instance Identifiers; the first element is the primary identifier.

InstanceLabel.description: Candidate identifier label of the instance.

LabelConfidenceLevel.description: Confidence level [0..1] of this identifier hypothesis.

Taxonomy.description: Taxonomy associated with this candidate identifier.

TaxonomyLevelIDs.description: Hierarchical taxonomy path as an ordered list of level identifiers.

TaxonomyConfidenceLevel.description: Confidence level [0..1] of the taxonomy association.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Instance Identifier in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Instance Identifier (plain text, max 2048 characters).
